contracts.signal: Quanta Computer and Quantinuum announced a collaborative development agreement (August 13, 2026) to jointly develop critical hardware infrastructure supporting future generations of Quantinuum's quantum systems - co-developing the infrastructure, systems engineering and manufacturing capabilities toward commercially deployable, large-scale, fault-tolerant systems, with joint engineering work already underway to make future quantum computers more modular, manufacturable and scalable. CEO Raj Hazra: it is time for quantum computing to move to 'breakthroughs in system manufacturing that can be deployed and operated at scale'.
